entry.title: Dual Slope 1.2.1
entry.summary: Dual Slope: two rise-and-fall generators (envelopes, LFOs, slew) that modulate other tracks, based on Befaco's Rampage VCV Rack module. ## What's new in 1.2.1 Built on sd88me's fixed wrapper ([mpc-vst-plugins#499](https://github.com/sd88me/mpc-vst-plugins/discussions/499)): on track edit → automation, the physical Q-Links move this plugin's parameters again (before, they didn't move or snapped straight back). entry.title: Dual Slope 1.2.0
entry.summary: Dual Slope: two rise-and-fall generators (envelopes, LFOs, slew) that modulate other tracks, based on Befaco's Rampage VCV Rack module. ## Requirements - A first-generation MPC OS standalone device (32-bit ARM, like the Force, MPC Live / Live II, One, X and Key 61). The installer refuses anything else. Newer models are untested. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Tested on MPC OS with a Force.
